name: sparkit-science-sparkit-mcp
description: MCP server for [SPARKIT](https://sparkit.science), a scientific research agent that searches the literature, reads papers, and returns cited Markdown reports. Submit a question via the `research` tool from Claude Desktop / Cursor / Claude Code; get back a ~90-second cited report without leaving the chat. `uv tool install sparkit-mcp` or `pip install sparkit-mcp`.
